# Extract the last two competitions by sorting by year descending and taking the top two rows
last_two = df.sort_values('year', ascending=False).head(2)
# Calculate the average of the 'notes' column for these rows, converting to numeric by extracting the numeric part
average_distance = last_two['notes'].str.extract(r'(\d+\.?\d*)').astype(float).mean()
# Compare the calculated average to the claimed average (78.27) and return a boolean
answer = bool(abs(average_distance - 78.27) < 1e-9)
